author: MathWolf49
body:
I got banned about 10 minutes ago by SirSyanide for "Hacking [ForceField] [AntiKnockback]".
First of all, what makes you think I'm hacking, force field isn't even a hack, I even got knocked off of a bridge, I don't have Anti KnockBack either. Earlier I got Temp banned for "Derp Hacking", just a mod that makes my head look funny, which after the temp ban i uninstalled it and never used it again, i only play this and 1 other server, i would never hack on one of my favorite servers.... I dont think I should be un-banned because I try to be nice to other people, sometimes i have crazy lag that makes me LOOK like I'm hacking, but I'm not. :/ Please Think of my offer, and i will wait a few days to get un-banned. I don't think i did anything wrong, I was playing 100% fair. This is depressing, since its the first time I've been perm banned on a server.
~MathWolf49
